mapper.select:
SELECT FROM manufacturing_process
AND LOCATE(#{code}, process_code) > 0 AND LOCATE(#{name}, process_name) > 0
ORDER BY process_id DESC
SELECT FROM manufacturing_process WHERE process_id = #{processId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM manufacturing_process WHERE process_code = #{processCode})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO manufacturing_process (process_code, process_name, description, is_active, created_by) VALUES (#{processCode}, #{processName}, #{description}, #{isActive}, #{createdBy})
